# Stage 3c corpus phrase list (plans/speech-rules/plan.md, "Stage 3c -- state-dependent
# speech-to-text hint", step 3). Read by tools/record_corpus.py --phrases-file.
#
# Lines starting with # are comments (including this block) and blank lines are skipped.
# Record each phrase at the default --takes repetitions.
#
# Aircraft state does not matter while recording: the corpus is audio only. Which state each
# phrase counts as being said in is decided when the bench runs, so record everything at the
# desk, with the cockpit headset, at a normal speaking level.
#
# Revised 2026-11-18: "straight" removed (the command was dropped); "turn left 30" removed (it is
# said exactly like "turn left thirty"); the refusal-case repeats of "turn left thirty" removed
# (same audio, the state is the bench's job); every other shipped flight.lua wording added.

# Turn: natural number word and digit by digit
turn left thirty
turn right forty five
turn left three zero
turn right one two zero

# Heading: always three digits
heading three one five
heading zero nine zero
heading two seven zero

# Level
level flight
level off

# Speed
speed two hundred
speed max
speed one hundred fifty three
speed two two zero
slow down
speed up

# Altitude
altitude three hundred
altitude three hundred twenty
altitude three two zero radar
altitude three zero zero barometric
alt one five zero
climb fifty
descend one hundred
hold altitude
hold alt

# HVRT bare words, said once each in isolation
left
right
forward
back
hold
up
down

# Control handover (a no-op in AI-overlay mode, recognised all the same)
you have controls
i have controls

# Commands that are out of place while flying (the bench removes them from the hint for the
# "flying" state; they must still be heard)
watch nearest
binoculars
scan ahead

# Non-command sentences, for contrast (real entries from vocabulary.FREE_SPEECH_GUARD)
look at that
the tanks are on the ridge
describe the mission to me
silence is golden
be careful
